subject: Invoicing acceptance & vendor registration: VAT ID / PO formatting
messages:
From: Laura Smith <laura.smith@biovista.com>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@biovista.com
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding + PO metadata we need

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the demo last week — Biovista is ready to move forward. Procurement has two quick asks before we can create a PO and set Redwood up as a vendor in our portal:  

1) What exact invoice header fields do you need for e-invoicing (UBL) so our AP system accepts invoices automatically? We typically require: supplier name, VAT ID, invoice number, invoice date, PO number, line-item descriptions, and unit/qty.

2) For EU VAT handling, do you bill with a Redwood VAT number or should we collect your company VAT ID and self-bill?

3) Bank details / IBAN and SWIFT — if you prefer, we can accept a bank stub or a direct-bank verification PDF.

Can you send an AP onboarding packet or a short checklist we can attach in our vendor portal? Our vendor portal link is: https://vendor-portal.biovista.com/register

Would like to get the PO out by EOD Monday (our procurement window).

Best,
Laura
Laura Smith
Senior Procurement Manager
Biovista Therapeutics

--

From: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Laura Smith <laura.smith@biovista.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding + PO metadata we need

Hi Laura — thanks, and congrats on moving to PO. See answers below and attached onboarding packet. Summary first, then details:  

Summary / next steps:
- Attached: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet.pdf (contains invoice examples + required fields).
- For EU customers we can provide either a Redwood VAT registration number (we have a consolidated EU VAT entity) or a VAT statement for each invoice. Please confirm which you prefer — most customers (and auditors) prefer we provide our VAT number on invoices.
- Bank details: we'll upload IBAN + SWIFT as a "bank stub" (Vendor_Bank_Stub.txt) to your portal if that works — otherwise we can provide a copy of a bank letter.
- E-invoice: We support UBL 2.1 with the following minimally required XML tags: AccountingSupplierParty (name, VATNumber), Invoice (ID, IssueDate), PurchaseOrderReference (ID), InvoiceLine (Description, InvoicedQuantity, UnitPrice), TaxTotal (TaxAmount), LegalMonetaryTotal (PayableAmount). The onboarding packet includes a sample UBL-built invoice.

Details / attachments:
- Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet.pdf: short checklist, sample PDF invoice, UBL sample snippet, billing email (ap@redwood.com), and recommended PO metadata mapping.
- Redwood_Tax_Statement.pdf: our EU VAT registration summary (registration country, VAT number, and tax representative if needed).
- Vendor_Bank_Stub.txt: contains the IBAN / SWIFT we will register in your portal. (We redact the account number in this thread; full stub attached via secure upload.)

Invoice acceptance rules we ask customers to follow (to avoid rejection/back-and-forth):
- PO must be present on the invoice in the PurchaseOrderReference field and visible on the PDF.
- Invoice header must include Redwood Inference Ltd (legal entity), our VAT ID (in attached tax statement), and the billing contact ap@redwood.com.
- Preferred invoice delivery: email to ap@redwood.com OR UBL push to your e-invoice endpoint.
- Payment terms: Net 30 unless otherwise negotiated in contract. If you require Net 45 we can accommodate but need to update SOW.

If you send the portal invite/registration link and the contact name, Monica (cc'd, finance) will complete the vendor registration and upload the bank stub. Markus (cc'd) is on the thread for any legal wording around EU tax handling.

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if anything needs clarification.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0168

Attachments: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet.pdf, Redwood_Tax_Statement.pdf, Vendor_Bank_Stub.txt
From: Procurement Team <procurement@biovista.com>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding + PO metadata we need

Evelyn / Marissa — quick follow-up from our AP integrator team:  

1) Our e-invoice validator will reject invoices that do not include a VATNumber element under AccountingSupplierParty. Please ensure your UBL exports include that element (your packet sample looks good).
2) For bank verification, our portal requires either an uploaded bank confirmation letter (on bank letterhead) OR a PDF bank statement from the last 3 months (account name and IBAN visible). A redacted stub is acceptable for initial PO issuance, but final vendor approval needs one of the two documents above.
3) We have a mandatory tax form checkbox: if Redwood is non-EU, we mark "reverse charge" and we will need the seller's VAT or a declaration. Please confirm the exact legal name and VAT ID to appear on the PO.

Portal link (for vendor registration): https://vendor-portal.biovista.com/register
Contact for upload issues: vendor-support@biovista.com

If you can upload the bank confirmation and VAT statement by EOD today, we can generate the PO tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Laura (on behalf of AP Integrations)

--
